paragraphs.text: I'm a Ph.D. candidate at [Old Dominion University](https://www.odu.edu/)'s [Accessible Computing Lab](https://www.cs.odu.edu/~vashok/Lab/index.html), advised by [Dr. Vikas Ashok](https://www.cs.odu.edu/~vashok/). My work bridges Human-Centered AI, accessibility and usability, social computing, computing education, healthcare simulation, responsible AI, and agentic LLM evaluation.

Currently I work with the [Health, Education, and AI Learning (HEAL) group](https://oduinnovate.org/research-enterprise/health-education-ai-learning/) at ODU, where I research interactions between healthcare-provider students and standardized patients (SPs) in OSCEs (Objective Structured Clinical Examinations) for multimodal evaluation of both the students' clinical skills and the SPs' acting skills. In Summer 2026, I worked as an Applied Science Intern at [MAP Communications](https://www.mapcommunications.com/), where I built multimodal evaluation pipelines to analyze calls between humans and AI customer-service agents for conversation quality, policy compliance, and escalation handling. Before the Ph.D., I worked at [London Stock Exchange Group](https://www.lseg.com/) and [BetaNXT](https://www.betanxt.com/).
